description: Explains what Kilotest is, what its tools do, and how its results are structured. Use this before any other tool when the available tools or workflow are unclear. Returns a prose overview of the Kilotest domain, the tool workflow, and links to further documentation. Kilotest integrates an ensemble of 12 rule engines, with about 1,300 rules, to test web pages for front-end quality (accessibility, usability, and web standards, including HTML, CSS, ARIA, and WCAG). Each test job generates a standardized report describing which elements violated which rules and grouping the violations into about 380 issues. Kilotest can list the tested pages, the reports about each page, the issues in each report, the violators of each issue, and the diagnoses of each violation. Kilotest also accepts requests to test pages not yet tested and to retest already tested pages.
name: getKilotestOverview
